# STORMO! Magazine

> An authoritative online resource dedicated to Italian WWII aviation history, scale modeling, and the Regia Aeronautica and Aeronautica Nazionale Repubblicana.

STORMO! is a specialized magazine and community hub for aviation enthusiasts, modelers, and historians focused on Italian military aircraft from World War II. The site combines historical research, modeling guides, product sales, and community forums to serve both serious historians and scale modeling hobbyists.

## Key Topics

- Regia Aeronautica
- Aeronautica Nazionale Repubblicana
- WWII aviation
- Italian aircraft
- Aircraft modeling
- Scale models
- Aviation history
- Aircraft markings
- Macchi C.200
- Model reviews
- Modeling community
- Italian air force
- Military history
- Camouflage colors
- Decals and markings

## Core Resources

- [STORMO! Homepage](https://www.stormomagazine.com/index.htm): Main homepage for STORMO! magazine covering Italian WWII aviation history
- [About STORMO!](https://www.stormomagazine.com/aboutme.htm): Information about STORMO! magazine and its mission
- [STORMO! Gallery](https://www.stormomagazine.com/Gallery_1a.html): Gallery showcasing scale models and aircraft references for Regia Aeronautica
- [STORMO! Forums](https://stormomagazine.com/phpbb2/index.php): Community forum for aircraft modeling and Italian aviation discussion
- [New Forum Posts](https://stormomagazine.com/phpbb2/NewForumPosts3.php): Feed of recent community forum discussions and posts

## Modeling Guides & Technical References

- [Color Guides](https://www.stormomagazine.com/ColorGuides.htm): Reference guides for camouflage colors and aircraft markings
- [How-to Articles](https://www.stormomagazine.com/howto.htm): How-to guides for model building, painting, and decaling techniques
- [STORMO! Decals](https://stormomagazine.com/Decals_Stormo.htm): STORMO! decals product page for Italian aircraft markings and insignia
- [Videos](https://www.stormomagazine.com/Videos.htm): Archive of historical footage and educational videos on Italian aircraft

## Historical Content

- [History Articles](https://www.stormomagazine.com/references.htm): Historical articles on Regia Aeronautica combat operations and aircraft
- [What's New](https://www.stormomagazine.com/whatsnew.html): Updates on new model reviews and modeler features

## Products & Services

- [STORMO! Products](https://www.stormomagazine.com/Products.htm): Storefront for STORMO! books, decals, and modeling products
- [STORMO! Services](https://www.stormomagazine.com/services.htm): Custom model painting and aircraft replica services
